note: Pirate, three-quarter view facing image-left, cutlass held in the left (image-left) fist. Head is the tricorn hat with the hair, ear and full beard, bottom y~466 at the beard tip; the white collar, vest, belt and the long dark coat are torso. Left arm is foreshortened against the body edge: a narrow sleeve upper arm (x~398-416, y476-566) to the elbow y~566, then the brown leather cuff forearm running left to the wrist x~345-375, bare fist and brown wrap (x290-378, y598-692). The cutlass is equipment: the long blade up to its tip at (222,326), the diagonal crossguard and the brown grip above the fist, kept off the peach fingers. Right arm: sleeve upper arm to the blue fold at y~592, forearm with the pink cuff to the wrist y~688, bare hand y688-768. The coat hem is the hip (left y~813, right y~832); the bare skin showing between hem and boot tops is thigh (left to y843, right to y853); boot tops are above halfway so they are the knees; the boot shafts are lower leg to the ankles (left y~893, right y~899) and the boot toes are feet.
